# Raw Input — Black AI & Tech Culture Platform

> The home of Black AI and tech culture. Creators, code, commentary, and community — no filter.

## What is Raw Input?

Raw Input is a community-driven platform for Black AI and tech enthusiasts featuring creator spotlights, AI news, job opportunities, educational resources, comedy, and deep investigative journalism — all written in an authentic, culturally fluent voice.

## Content Sections

- **Who Trained You?** — Spotlights on Black AI creators, engineers, and founders
- **The Wire** — AI and tech news filtered for the Black tech community
- **BLACKBOX** — Deep investigative journalism on AI bias, ethics, and power
- **Root Access** — Tech job listings, grants, fellowships, and career resources
- **The Bag** — Making money with AI, gig economy analysis, side hustle engineering
- **Fork It** — Open source repos, free tools, and resources from Black/diaspora developers
- **The Scoreboard** — Tech-related sports coverage (athletes x AI, wearables, fantasy ML)
- **The Ticker** — Comedian commentary on Polymarket bets and financial markets
- **City Mode** — Local tech scenes in Atlanta, NYC, LA, DMV, Houston, Detroit, London, Lagos, Accra
- **The Manual** — Free AI courses, tutorials, certifications, and learning paths
- **Papers** — Scientific paper breakdowns in accessible, culturally fluent language
- **The Break Room** — Daily tech jokes, memes, and water cooler content
- **Log Off** — Remote work destinations, wellness, cooking, travel deals for tech workers
- **Who Cooked?** — Social experiment: culture-trained AI vs generic AI on real topics
- **The Panel** — AI personas of historical/cultural figures discussing modern tech
- **Marketplace** — Digital products, prompt packs, templates from Black creators
- **Directory** — Black-founded AI companies, HBCU programs, grants database

## Key Features

- 3 AI editorial agents with distinct voices (Maya, Dex, OG-PT)
- Autonomous content engine updated daily via 12 AI loops
- 400+ free educational resources aggregated including HillmanTok University
- Real-time job board with salary transparency and "real talk" descriptions
- Scientific paper breakdowns making academic research accessible
- Supply chain ripple analysis connecting macro events to community impact
- Gamification with XP, badges, and learning paths

## Free Resources

Raw Input aggregates and contextualizes free educational content from:
- HillmanTok University (400+ courses from Black educators)
- MIT OpenCourseWare, DeepLearning.AI, fast.ai, Google ML courses
- freeCodeCamp, Khan Academy, Harvard CS50, HuggingFace courses
